minutes.headline: Personnel Committee set a new part-time data collector at grade eight, approved new language letting the town manager pay temporary extra duties, and approved 28 job descriptions.
minutes.summary: The committee met remotely and approved prior minutes. It set the grade for a new 19-hour assessing data collector, approved a grade four step two start for a new lifeguard, and revised the temporary-position language in the town's pay plan section. It then approved a batch of revised job descriptions and adjourned. The minute-taker's last meeting was acknowledged at the end.

votes.motion: Accept the April 30, 2024 minutes as submitted.
Set the new assessing data collector job at grade eight.
Accept the recreation director's recommendation to hire the new lifeguard at grade four, step two.
Approve the revised wording of the temporary-duty paragraph in the pay plan section for referral to town meeting.
Approve the 28 listed job descriptions as submitted.

budget_items.what_was_said: The position was approved at town meeting for 19 hours. It cannot go over that without triggering benefits.

budget_items.topic: Pay grid for grades seven and eight
budget_items.what_was_said: Members read the FY25 grid ranges for grade seven and grade eight while comparing the role to similar positions.
Staff said the 25,000 is a budget cap, not a pay cap, and at about 25 an hour for 19 hours there is little wiggle room. Members noted extra funds might be found if needed.
The new lifeguard starts at grade four step two. The rate changes on July 1, so June is paid at the lower rate.

The Building Commissioner would go from 36 to 38 hours a week while taking on land use management duties, with compensation by a step increase. Members discussed stipends and overtime as alternatives.

decisions.decision: Step placement for the data collector will be decided when a candidate is identified; only the grade was set tonight.
Julie will share the revised paragraph with the town manager (Heather) on her return, and the committee will meet again if adjustments are needed.
No job description review is needed for the Building Commissioner or land use manager, since the new language covers temporary duties.
Once the job descriptions are approved, they go to the department head, town manager and Personnel chair for DocuSign sign-off.
The meal site manager title will be made consistent with other Council on Aging job descriptions at a later point.

what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee unanimously set a new part-time assessing data collector job at grade eight; step placement waits until a candidate is identified.
The committee unanimously approved revised wording on temporary extra duties in the pay plan section, for referral to town meeting.
The committee unanimously approved 28 revised job descriptions as submitted; they go next to the department head, town manager and Personnel chair for DocuSign sign-off.
The committee unanimously accepted a recommendation to hire a new lifeguard at grade four, step two.

why_it_matters: The temporary-duty wording changes how the town can pay staff who take on extra work, such as the Building Commissioner covering land use, and it is headed to a town meeting vote residents may be asked to take.
The data collector role was approved at town meeting for 19 hours because more hours would trigger benefits, so its grade and hourly rate fit inside a fixed budget line, with little room above it.
